name: Prinz et al. 2003/2004 stomatogastric AB/PD pacemaker neuron (AB_PD_3 parameter set)
citation: Prinz AA, Billimoria CP, Marder E (2003). Alternative to Hand-Tuning Conductance-Based Models: Construction and Analysis of Databases of Model Neurons. Journal of Neurophysiology 90(6):3998-4015. doi:10.1152/jn.00641.2003 | Prinz AA, Bucher D, Marder E (2004). Similar network activity from disparate circuit parameters. Nature Neuroscience 7(12):1345-1352. doi:10.1038/nn1352
expected_behavior: Single compartment; Na, CaT, CaS, KA, KCa, Kd, H (Ih), Ca pool. Expected bursting pacemaker (AB/PD). Screening (jNeuroML, not calibrated, not eFEL; verification.json run 2026-09-13T16:00:56+00:00_aa8fa6a0): shipped harness gives 40 spikes in 5 s in 2 bursts on slow waves; spontaneously active. Hyperpolarisation with depolarising recovery in a spontaneously active cell: -0.3 nA for 1 s reaches -124.5 mV at +264 ms and recovers by 43.2 mV before release, then 13 rebound spikes. Sag ratio undefined (spikes in the pre-step baseline window). Ih contribution to that recovery untested: the Ih-block run of this protocol aborted in jLEMS. At -0.1 nA (spikes during the step with and without Ih) blocking Ih lowered the end-of-step potential by 12.3 mV.
inclusion_reason: Candidate for the bursting and rebound gaps (independent source, MIT, jnml-valid). Not shown to fill the Ih/sag gap: sag ratio is undefined in this spontaneously active cell and the Ih-block control of the recovering protocol aborted. Decisions needed: rheobase for spontaneously active cells (fallback 0.1 nA used), canonical window (earliest harness pulse is 0-100 ms), burst onsets 1.6 s apart vs 700-1000 ms protocols; harness is a network (AB_PD is presynaptic only).

name: Prinz et al. 2003/2004 stomatogastric LP neuron (LP_2 parameter set)
citation: Prinz AA, Billimoria CP, Marder E (2003). Alternative to Hand-Tuning Conductance-Based Models: Construction and Analysis of Databases of Model Neurons. Journal of Neurophysiology 90(6):3998-4015. doi:10.1152/jn.00641.2003 | Prinz AA, Bucher D, Marder E (2004). Similar network activity from disparate circuit parameters. Nature Neuroscience 7(12):1345-1352. doi:10.1038/nn1352
expected_behavior: Single compartment; STG channel set without CaT, H 0.05 mS/cm2. Screening (run 2026-09-13T16:00:56+00:00_aa8fa6a0): shipped harness LP[0] (0 nS synapse, no pulse) fires 25 spikes in 5 s, median ISI 210 ms; spontaneously active. -0.3 nA for 1 s (no spike before or during the step): sag ratio 0.24, recovery 6.5 mV, 16 rebound spikes. Ih-block control (H density 0, same current): sag and recovery fall to about 0, end-of-step potential 9.8 mV lower, 10 rebound spikes, so the screened sag depends on Ih. At -0.1 and -0.2 nA the cell spikes during the step, so sag is undefined there.
inclusion_reason: Candidate only together with prinz2004_abpd (same paper, channel files and harness; never split across discovery/held-out). Clearest Ih-dependent sag in the screen, but from one protocol in a spontaneously active cell. Its recorded cell receives no stimulus in the shipped harness, so the canonical test is spontaneous activity.

name: Maex and De Schutter 1998 cerebellar granule cell (Granule_98)
citation: Maex R, De Schutter E (1998). Synchronization of Golgi and Granule Cell Firing in a Detailed Network Model of the Cerebellar Granule Cell Layer. Journal of Neurophysiology 80(5):2521-2537. doi:10.1152/jn.1998.80.5.2521
expected_behavior: Single compartment (10 um); NaF, KDr, KA, KCa, CaHVA, H (Ih), Ca pool. Screening (run 2026-09-13T16:00:56+00:00_aa8fa6a0): silent at rest; rheobase 0.0051 nA; tonic non-adapting firing (ISI ratio 0.93); sag ratio 0.23 at -0.0051 nA (recovery 5.2 mV), near zero at -0.010 and -0.015 nA; no rebound. Ih-block control: at -0.0051 nA sag and recovery fall to 0 and the end-of-step potential is 33.6 mV lower; rest is 5.3 mV more negative; the -0.015 nA block run aborted in jLEMS. 0.05 nA steps abort jLEMS (GOhm input resistance).
inclusion_reason: Candidate with caveats: no single-cell harness shipped (canonical protocol must be authored or the model excluded from canonical comparison); default rheobase bracket (0.5 nA) crashes jLEMS; Ih sag is Ih-dependent in the block control but weak and present only at the mildest step.

name: Maex and De Schutter 1998 cerebellar Golgi cell (Golgi_98)
citation: Maex R, De Schutter E (1998). Synchronization of Golgi and Granule Cell Firing in a Detailed Network Model of the Cerebellar Granule Cell Layer. Journal of Neurophysiology 80(5):2521-2537. doi:10.1152/jn.1998.80.5.2521
expected_behavior: Single compartment (30 um); NaF, KDr, KA, KCa, CaHVA (Nernst), H, Ca pool. Screening (run 2026-09-13T16:00:56+00:00_aa8fa6a0): spontaneous pacemaking ~7 Hz (ISI CV 0.002); strong spike-frequency adaptation under depolarisation (ISI last/first 3.3 at +0.2 nA, 3.5 at +0.15 nA 2 s); 3-4 rebound spikes after hyperpolarisation. Sag ratio undefined (spike in the pre-step baseline window). At -0.1 nA V recovers 12.5 mV from its late trough; with Ih blocked there is no recovery and V ends at -162 mV instead of -75 mV, so Ih strongly limits hyperpolarisation. Ih-block runs at -0.2 and -0.3 nA aborted in jLEMS.
inclusion_reason: Recommended candidate for the independent-source adapting model. Ih is functionally large in the block control but a sag ratio is not established. Decisions needed: no single-cell harness shipped; spontaneous activity makes rheobase normalisation fall back to 0.1 nA. Same family as maex1998_granule.

name: Single-compartment cell with the Smith et al. 2013 L2/3 pyramidal channel set (OSB test cell)
citation: Smith SL, Smith IT, Branco T, Häusser M (2013). Dendritic spikes enhance stimulus selectivity in cortical neurons in vivo. Nature 503(7474):115-120. doi:10.1038/nature12600
expected_behavior: Single compartment; na, kv, km, kca, ca, it (fixed erev), pas; no Ca pool. Screening (run 2026-09-13T16:00:56+00:00_aa8fa6a0): shipped harness 7 spikes matching NEURON .mep (max 0.11 ms); rheobase 0.0219 nA; tonic regular non-adapting firing (ISI ratio 1.01-1.02); no sag, no rebound.
inclusion_reason: Recommended candidate for tonic spiking with a distinct threshold (independent source, exact OMV reference). Not a published single-compartment model (OSB-assembled test cell). Canonical window rule picks the -0.01 nA pulse, missing all spikes (build note).

name: Migliore et al. 2014 olfactory bulb mitral-cell soma (MT_soma test cell)
citation: Migliore M, Cavarretta F, Hines ML, Shepherd GM (2014). Distributed organization of a brain microcircuit analyzed by three-dimensional modeling: the olfactory bulb. Frontiers in Computational Neuroscience 8. doi:10.3389/fncom.2014.00050
expected_behavior: Single compartment; nax (shifted), kdrmt, kamt (A-type), pas. Screening (run 2026-09-13T16:00:56+00:00_aa8fa6a0): shipped harness 1 spike matching .mep (0.06 ms); rheobase 0.0248 nA; delayed low-rate regular firing (latency 18 ms, ISI 73-79 ms at 2x rheobase); slight ISI lengthening (1.24 over 2 s); no sag or rebound.
inclusion_reason: Recommended candidate (independent source, low-rate A-current firing). Soma-only test cell exported from a multicompartment model; shipped canonical harness is only 100 ms with one spike.

name: Migliore et al. 2014 olfactory bulb granule-cell soma (GC_soma test cell)
citation: Migliore M, Cavarretta F, Hines ML, Shepherd GM (2014). Distributed organization of a brain microcircuit analyzed by three-dimensional modeling: the olfactory bulb. Frontiers in Computational Neuroscience 8. doi:10.3389/fncom.2014.00050
expected_behavior: Single compartment (8 um); nax, kdrmt, kamt, pas; Cm 4 uF/cm2. Screening (run 2026-09-13T16:00:56+00:00_aa8fa6a0): shipped harness 2 spikes matching .mep (0.15 ms); rheobase 0.0026 nA; phasic near threshold (1 spike at 2x rheobase for 500 ms, 2 spikes at 1.5x over 2 s); no sag or rebound. 0.05 nA steps abort jLEMS.
inclusion_reason: Candidate with caveats: phasic/sparse firing gives few spike features; same family as migliore2014_mt_soma; default rheobase bracket crashes jLEMS (small soma).
